context: Tests whether the agent correctly updates deprecated OpenTelemetry HTTP attribute names to their current equivalents, applies the correct URL attributes for client vs server spans, renames HTTP duration metrics and their units, and handles non-standard HTTP method values using the _OTHER pattern.

checklist.name: http.request.method used
checklist.description: Uses `http.request.method` instead of the deprecated `http.method` for HTTP method attribute

checklist.name: url.full on client spans
checklist.description: Uses `url.full` on CLIENT (outbound) HTTP spans instead of deprecated `http.url`

checklist.name: url.path on server spans
checklist.description: Uses `url.path` (and `url.query` where applicable) on SERVER (inbound) spans instead of `http.target`

checklist.name: url.full NOT on server spans
checklist.description: Does NOT use `url.full` on SERVER spans — only `url.path`, `url.query`, `url.scheme`

checklist.name: Duration unit seconds
checklist.description: HTTP duration metric is recorded in seconds (e.g., `0.245`), NOT milliseconds (e.g., `245`)

checklist.name: _OTHER normalization
checklist.description: Non-standard HTTP method values are set to `_OTHER` in `http.request.method`, with the original value stored in `http.request.method_original`
